subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should an opted-in deferred-maintenance timeout preserve the existing one-in-flight-per-session `ContextEngine.maintain()` behavior for legacy plugins, rather than requiring every shipped engine to become re-entrant?
rationale: The PR changes a public plugin lifecycle guarantee. A code repair can preserve the established serialization contract, but maintainers must decide whether any explicit future capability should permit overlap instead.

options.title: Preserve legacy serialization
options.body: Release the user-facing lane at timeout but keep subsequent same-session maintenance coalesced behind the unfinished invocation.

options.title: Add an explicit engine capability later
options.body: Only engines that explicitly declare safe re-entrant maintenance may use overlapping calls; legacy engines retain serialization.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy serialization
recommendation.body: Release the user-facing lane at timeout but keep subsequent same-session maintenance coalesced behind the unfinished invocation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a compatibility decision for the public context-engine lifecycle contract.
